detailMarkdown:
# Claude Code Repo Migration Debugging Capability Pack Skill

Expert Claude Code skill capability pack for diagnosing repository migrations, dependency upgrades, build failures, and cross-file debugging with controlled validation.

## Trust
- Source: source-backed
- Package: maintainer-built/verified package
- Review: unclaimed

## Safety notes
- Migration debugging may run package manager scripts, tests, builds, generators, and git commands; review scripts before executing unfamiliar project code.
- Avoid broad dependency upgrades, generated artifact churn, or formatting sweeps unless the migration explicitly requires them.
- Create rollback points before destructive commands, data migrations, lockfile rewrites, or cross-package refactors.

## Privacy notes
- Build logs, stack traces, test fixtures, environment names, and repository paths may expose proprietary architecture or credentials.
- Do not include secrets from .env files, CI logs, npm configs, or cloud credentials in prompts, commits, or final reports.
- External package registries and documentation lookups may reveal package names and version constraints.

## Install
```bash
curl -L https://heyclau.de/downloads/skills/claude-code-repo-migration-debugging-capability-pack.zip -o claude-code-repo-migration-debugging-capability-pack.zip && unzip -o claude-code-repo-migration-debugging-capability-pack.zip -d ./claude-code-repo-migration-debugging-capability-pack
```

## Usage
Use this skill when Claude Code must migrate a repo, upgrade dependencies, debug failing tests/builds, or recover from a partially applied refactor.
